title: Say hi with an f-string
prompt:
Monty wants to hear you say hello properly.

The starter code reads a name with input(). Print a greeting using an f-string so the output looks exactly like:

Hi Monty, I'm <name>!

For example, if the name is Gee, print: Hi Monty, I'm Gee!
hints: An f-string starts with f before the quotes, and you put variables in curly braces: f"Hello {name}"
Write print(f"Hi Monty, I'm {name}!") under the first line.
starter_code:
name = input()
